build.description: Build every workspace package and cache its emitted artifacts.

lint.description: Run package-level lint and static analysis.

test.description: Run package unit tests after dependency builds.

test:coverage.description: Run Vitest coverage tasks for packages that expose a coverage script.

typecheck.description: Run TypeScript validation across the workspace after dependency builds.

format.description: Write formatting changes with Oxfmt for package files.

format:check.description: Verify formatting with Oxfmt while hashing the shared root formatter config.

check.description: Run the full package verification pipeline: lint, format, test, and typecheck.

run.description: Run the built CLI after compiling it.

clean.description: Remove package build artifacts without caching the cleanup step.
